posts.title: Free solo: King Bee Direct
posts.description: For a wee while I’ve wanted to solo the popular line that runs the full height of Creag Dubh: King Bee Direct. I wondered if the new bolt belay that was placed halfway up the route, after pitch 2, might have allowed the top two pitches to become a bit dirty (I was correct!). So I cleaned them both first.
